values.note: Open the 3rd Friday in April through the 4th Monday in October, weather permitting (the dates move each year).

season.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/babcock-state-park/lodging/ ('The campground is open 3rd Friday in April through the 4th Monday in October, weather permitting'; 'Open late April through late October'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 28 electric sites (four accessible) and 24 non-electric; tents or trailers.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/babcock-state-park/lodging/ ('52-unit campground, 28 sites with electric-only hookups, four of which are accessible and 24 non-electric sites'; 'Accommodates tents or trailers'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/babcock-state-park/lodging/ ('28 sites with electric-only hookups'; 'Two water fill-up stations and two sewage facilities'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Central bathhouse with coin-operated laundry; two water fill-up stations and two sewage (dump) facilities; firewood and ice sold.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/babcock-state-park/lodging/ ('has a central bathhouse with coin-operated laundry', 'Two water fill-up stations and two sewage facilities', 'Firewood and ice are available for purchase', 'WiFi is available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve online (WV State Parks booking site), by phone or at the park headquarters office. Weekend (Friday and Saturday) reservations need both nights; one night Sunday-Thursday.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/babcock-state-park/lodging/ ('Campsites may be reserved anytime online, by phone or at the park headquarters office', 'Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Fri. and Sat.) or one night (Sun.-Thurs.)', '14-night maximum stay'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the inherited reservable/booking site/2-night weekend minimum/14-night max for Babcock.
